findings.title: Hardcoded API secret in source code
findings.description: A production API secret is committed in plaintext within the source file, accessible to anyone with repository access.

findings.title: Unvalidated redirect allows open redirect attack
findings.description: The redirect URL is taken from user input without an allow-list check, enabling phishing via trusted domain redirects.

findings.title: Verbose error message leaks internal path
findings.description: Error response includes absolute filesystem path in the message, disclosing server directory structure to clients.
